answers.text: Feed-forward qatlam — attentiondan keyin katta vektorni yaxshilash uchun alohida qatlam. Shunda token vaotuvchi modellar bilan bog‘liq shu vektorlarga muhim bo‘ladi.

Feed-forward qatlam — attentiondan keyin token vektorlari kichiklashini bajarish uchun oldindan o‘qitiladigan mezonlar hisoblab, shuning uchun softmax funksiyasi bilan alohida vektorga tenglash kerak. Feed-forward qatlam — Transformer har bir token qiymatin uchun alohida neyron tarmoqni quradigan model yangi ma’lumotlar o‘rganish uchun oldindan alohida saqlanadi va faqat uni keyingi bosqichga kiritiladi. Attention mexanizmiga mosligini ham foydali yordam beradi.
Feed-forward qatlam — biroz kichik, guruhli o‘qitiladigan neyron tarmoq. U matnning vazifani yangi bosqichga saqlaydi va attention mexanizmini kamaytiradi.

Feed-forward qatlam — attentiondan keyin token vektorni transformatror bilan o‘zgartirib boradigan model qatlami. U kichik gelischilishini kamaytiradi va Transformer matritsalarining bog‘lanishini kamaytiradi.

Feed-forward qatlam — self-attentiondan keyin tokenlar qidirishini ham modellashtiradigan hajmdan foydalanadigan kichik vektorga kiritadigan muzlat. U xotirasidan tashqari har bir neyron uni asosiy qo‘shimcha o‘zgartiradi va attentiondan keyin saqlaydi.
Feed-forward qatlam — attention kabi modellarga qarab ko‘rsatma qiladigan bilgilar saqlanmaydigan vazifaga misol. U xomni og‘irliklarni yuklash, adapter'lar qo‘shish usulini belgilaydi.

Feed-forward qatlam — attentiondan keyin kichik matritsalar orasidagi xotira qo‘shimcha o‘qitiladigan hujjatlar qo‘shish uchun amallayotgan vazifani ham o‘rganadi. U multilayerdastan iborat bo‘ladi va har biri yangi asosiy neyron tarmoqlardan iborat, masalan ResNetlardan iborat.

prompt: Practice question for my test: what is the difference between precision and recall?

answers.text: Precision shows how many of the model's "yes" answers are correct, while recall shows how many real "yes" cases the model found. For example, if you want to find sick children in a hospital, high precision means that most of those detected have symptoms, but low recall means that not all the sick kids were found.
Precision shows how many of your model's answers are correct, and recall shows how much of the real problem your model found. If you want to find both things well together, use F1 score instead.

Precision shows how many of the model's answers are correct. Recall shows how much information the model gives you, even when it can't answer everything. For example, if 10% of answers are right but the model finds all relevant texts, recall will be very high, but precision may still be low because not all questions have an exact answer.

Precision shows how many of your answers are correct, but it counts only those cases when your model says "yes". Recall shows how many really important cases you found. For example, if a disease has 1% prevalence in a population and no test can predict this with 90% accuracy, you need 50 patients to get even one correct result. Precision tells you that you already have one patient in two tests, so the answer looks positive. But recall will find none.
